title: AGAAZ-E-BAATCHEET: Building Youth Leadership for Community Transformation
excerpt: As part of IYLP-2026 with Rubaroo, Megh Foundation facilitated a youth leadership journey for 50 young leaders from urban and rural communities.
coverImageAlt: Youth leadership workshop session under AGAAZ-E-BAATCHEET
bodyMarkdown:
## Program snapshot

Megh Foundation conducted a Community Youth Leadership Program under **IYLP-2026 (Rubaroo, Hyderabad)**, bringing together 50 youth leaders from rural and urban backgrounds.

## Core learning experience

The AGAAZ-E-BAATCHEET module created space for:

- Self-reflection and identity-building
- Peace dialogue and active listening
- Values-based leadership development
- Community action planning

## Outcomes

Participants developed stronger leadership clarity, social awareness, and commitment to local action.

## Acknowledgement

The foundation extends gratitude to program supporters and facilitators who helped make this journey meaningful for every participant.
